aj: Hey @kevin @olivia — I pushed fixes for the schema migration PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/478. Addressed your comments about null checks and the batcher off-by-one. PTAL when you have a minute.

kevin: Thanks — I'll take a look after stand. Quick q: did you run the integration job? last time the migration hung on test DB.

aj: yes, ran locally and CI passed but integration is flaky. I added a retry with exponential backoff in pkg/db/migrate.go:
```diff
- if err := runMigration(...); err != nil {
-   return err
- }
+ for i:=0; i<3; i++ {
+   if err := runMigration(...); err==nil { break }
+   sleep(time.Millisecond * (100*(1<<i)))
+ }
```
pushed as 4f2b9c2. Also added a unit test for nil payload handling.

kevin: saw commit. Two small nits: 1) use context with timeout instead of sleep in prod path; 2) minor var name s/tx/txCtx for clarity. I'll approve after those.

aj: updated — swapped sleep to ctx-based retry and renamed var. PTAL again: 4f2b9c2 -> 8a7d1f0. Also added changelog entry. CI green.

olivia: LGTM from me, good catches. @maria need a second approver for merge per CODEOWNERS?

maria: On it, giving a quick look now.

maria: couple comments but non-blocking. Approved. :thumbsup: 

aj: thanks! Merge on green?

merge-bot: Merge queued for PR #478 by aj. Auto-merge when CI stable.

sre-oncall: Note: will watch the canary for 30m after deploy.

merge-bot: PR #478 merged by aj (commit 8a7d1f0). Deploy started to staging.

aj: thanks all, will monitor logs. :eyes: 

kevin: thanks, nice work.
